title: Zero-code capture for Node (TypeScript)
one_line: Record every OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Bedrock call in Node apps.
verified_against: openai 7.62.0, @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.12.0, @google/genai 3.6.1, @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime 3.1175.0 (installed packages read; calls exercised offline through each SDK's own fetch/requestHandler with fake JSON, SSE and AWS event-stream bodies; no live provider calls); Node 22.23.5 only; OTLP/JSON shape checked against opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otlp and opentelemetry-proto trace.proto (2026-11-21) and against briefcase's Python OTelExporter and receiver
